service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , LINE_TYPE , APP_TYPE , GETCODETEXT1( 'AP001', APP_TYPE, '#session.LANGUAGE#' , '#session.HOUSE_CODE#') AS APP_TYPE_TEXT , CODE , CASE WHEN LINE_TYPE = '03' THEN (SELECT ACCOUNT_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ACCOUNT_NAME DESC) RNUM FROM SAMST WHERE LANGUAGE = '#session.LANGUAGE#' AND ACCOUNT_CODE = SGWAD.CODE AND RNUM = 1) WHEN LINE_TYPE = '02' THEN GETDEPTNAME( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CODE, '#session.LANGUAGE#' ) END AS CODE_TEXT , LINE_SEQ , USER_ID , GETUSERNAME( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, '#session.LANGUAGE#' ) AS USER_NAME , APP_USER_AMT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ADD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ADD_TIME,'HH24MISS'),'HH24:MI:SS') AS ADD_TIME , GETUSERNAME( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, ADD_USER_ID, '#session.LANGUAGE#' ) AS ADD_USER_ID , USE_FLAG FROM SGWAD WHERE 1 = 1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND LINE_TYPE = ${LINE_TYPE} AND APP_TYPE = ${APP_TYPE} AND CODE = ${CODE}
